Approved 2026-09-04 — see design-system/SPECS.md for the full spec

Coral · gold · teal, on near-black

Background #121212, surface #1E1E1E, text #F5F5F5/#A0A0A0, primary coral #FF6B4A, gold #FFD166 used sparingly for badges/streaks, teal #00E0C7 for confirm/active. Every value AA-clear (worst case 6.38:1). All four accents take dark ink as fill text, never white — white-on-coral measures 2.58:1, white-on-gold 1.32:1; that exact mistake is already live in the shipped code and the spec is written to not repeat it. One dark identity, no day/night split — the Dubai-clock colour-switching mechanism is retired by owner decision; foundations/colour.html still shows the old sand/teal pair because it reads the live app tokens and Frontend hasn't shipped this yet.
